package typecheck
import("fmt";"encoding/json";"testing";"go/constant";"IMPORT_TYPES";"IMPORT_OBJ";"IMPORT_SRC";"IMPORT_IR";IMPORT_BASE)
func TestSyncgoNativeSnapshot(t *testing.T){
 SETUP
 UP.InitUniverse()
 var out []string
 for _,entry:=range UP.builtinFuncs{n:=TY.BuiltinPkg.Lookup(entry.name).Def.(*ir.Name);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("builtin:%s:%d:%d:%t",entry.name,n.BuiltinOp,n.Typecheck(),n.Sym().Def==n))}
 for _,entry:=range UP.unsafeFuncs{n:=TY.UnsafePkg.Lookup(entry.name).Def.(*ir.Name);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("unsafe:%s:%d:%d:%t",entry.name,n.BuiltinOp,n.Typecheck(),n.Sym().Def==n))}
 for _,kind:=range []types.Kind{types.TINT,types.TBOOL,types.TSTRING,types.TUINTPTR,types.TFLOAT32,types.TCOMPLEX128}{typ:=TY.Types[kind];n:=typ.Obj().(*ir.Name);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("type:%v:%d:%t:%t:%t",typ,typ.Size(),n.Type()==typ,n.Sym().Def==n,GRAPH.TypeNode(typ)==n))}
 for _,name:=range []string{"true","false"}{n:=TY.BuiltinPkg.Lookup(name).Def.(*ir.Name);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("constant:%s:%t:%t",name,constant.BoolVal(n.Val()),n.Type()==TY.UntypedBool))}
 blank:=GRAPH.BlankNode
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("blank:%t:%t:%t:%t",TY.BlankSym==UP.Lookup("_"),TY.BlankSym.Def==blank,blank.Type()==TY.Types[types.TBLANK],TY.BuiltinPkg.Lookup("_").Def!=blank))
 n:=TY.BuiltinPkg.Lookup("nil").Def.(ir.Node);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("nil:%v:%t",n,n.Type()==TY.Types[types.TNIL]))
 for op:=ir.Op(0);op<ir.OEND;op++{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("table:%d:%v",op,UP.okfor[op]))}
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("flags:%v:%v:%v",TY.IsSimple,TY.IsOrdered,GRAPH.OKForConst))
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("aliases:%t:%t:%t",&UP.okfor[ir.OADD][0]==&UP.okforadd[0],&UP.okfor[ir.OLT][0]==&TY.IsOrdered[0],&UP.okfor[ir.OXXX][0]==&UP.okfornone[0]))
 pos:=LINK.PosTable.XPos(src.MakePos(src.NewFileBase("fn.go","/src/fn.go"),3,2))
 fn:=GRAPH.NewFunc(pos,pos,UP.Lookup("F"),TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil))
 GRAPH.WithFunc(fn,func(){out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("scope:%t:%t:%s:%s",POS==pos,UP.NodNil().Pos()==pos,UP.AutoLabel(".loop").Name,UP.AutoLabel(".loop").Name))})
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("restored:%t:%t",GRAPH.CurFunc==nil,POS==(src.XPos{})))
 field:=TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("args"),TY.NewSlice(TY.Types[types.TINT]));field.SetIsDDD(true)
 params:=UP.NewFuncParams([]*types.Field{field})
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("params:%t:%t:%t:%t:%t",params[0]!=field,params[0].Type==field.Type,params[0].Sym==field.Sym,params[0].Pos==field.Pos,params[0].IsDDD()))

 UP.InitRuntime();UP.InitCoverage()
 for _,d:=range UP.runtimeDecls{n:=UP.LookupRuntime(d.name);out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("runtime:%s:%v:%d:%v:%t:%t:%s:%v",d.name,n.Class,n.Typecheck(),n.Type(),n.Sym().Def==n,n.Func!=nil,n.Linksym().Name,n.Linksym().ABI()))}
 coverage:=UP.LookupCoverage("initHook");out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("coverage:%v:%v:%s",coverage.Class,coverage.Type(),coverage.Linksym().Name))
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("ABI:%t:%t:%t",UP.LookupRuntime("newobject").Linksym()==UP.LookupRuntimeFunc("newobject"),UP.LookupRuntime("writeBarrier").Linksym()==UP.LookupRuntimeVar("writeBarrier"),UP.LookupRuntimeVar("newobject")!=UP.LookupRuntimeFunc("newobject")))
 for _,item:=range []struct{name string;args []*types.Type}{
 {"newobject",[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TINT]}},
 {"newobject",[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TSTRING]}},
 {"mapaccess1",[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TSTRING],TY.Types[types.TINT],TY.Types[types.TSTRING],TY.Types[types.TINT]}},
 {"chanrecv1",[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TINT],TY.Types[types.TINT]}},
 }{original:=UP.LookupRuntime(item.name);n:=UP.LookupRuntime(item.name,item.args...);TY.CalcSize(n.Type());out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("subst:%s:%v:%v:%t:%t:%t:%t:%t:%d",item.name,n.Type(),original.Type(),n!=original,n.Sym()==original.Sym(),n.Func==original.Func,n.Sym().Def==original,n.Type().ResultsTuple()!=original.Type().ResultsTuple(),n.Type().ArgWidth()))}
 placeholder:=TY.Types[types.TANY]
 structure:=TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{
 TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("a"),TY.NewArray(placeholder,2)),
 TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("b"),TY.NewSlice(placeholder)),
 TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("c"),TY.NewMap(placeholder,placeholder)),
 TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("d"),TY.NewChan(placeholder,types.Cboth)),
 })
 values:=[]*types.Type{TY.Types[types.TINT],TY.Types[types.TSTRING],TY.Types[types.TUINT],TY.ByteType,TY.Types[types.TBOOL]}
 substituted:=TY.SubstAny(structure,&values);TY.CalcSize(substituted)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("structure:%v:%v:%d:%d:%t:%t:%t:%t",structure,substituted,len(values),substituted.Size(),structure.Field(0)!=substituted.Field(0),structure.Field(0).Type!=substituted.Field(0).Type,structure.Field(2).Type!=substituted.Field(2).Type,substituted.Underlying()==substituted))
 // Build real native declarations and consume rewritten nodes.
 sig:=TY.NewSignature(nil,[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("x"),TY.Types[types.TINT])},[]*types.Field{TY.NewField(pos,nil,TY.Types[types.TINT])})
 checkedFn:=GRAPH.NewFunc(pos,pos,UP.Lookup("Checked"),sig)
 UP.DeclFunc(checkedFn)
 x:=sig.Param(0).Nname.(*ir.Name)
 tmp:=UP.TempAt(pos,checkedFn,TY.Types[types.TINT])
 add:=UP.Expr(GRAPH.NewBinaryExpr(pos,ir.OADD,x,GRAPH.NewInt(pos,3)))
 assign:=UP.Stmt(GRAPH.NewAssignStmt(pos,tmp,add))
 ret:=UP.Stmt(GRAPH.NewReturnStmt(pos,[]ir.Node{tmp}))
 checkedFn.Body=[]ir.Node{assign,ret}
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("checked:%v:%v:%d:%v:%v:%d:%v:%d:%t:%t",add,add.Type(),add.Typecheck(),assign,ret,len(checkedFn.Dcl),tmp.Sym(),tmp.Esc(),tmp.AutoTemp(),tmp.Curfn==checkedFn))
 if add.Type()!=TY.Types[types.TINT] || add.Typecheck()!=1 || assign.Typecheck()!=1 || ret.Typecheck()!=1 {t.Fatal("native body not checked")}
 inner:=GRAPH.NewFunc(pos,pos,UP.Lookup("Inner"),TY.NewSignature(nil,nil,nil));UP.DeclFunc(inner)
 innerTmp:=UP.TempAt(pos,inner,TY.Types[types.TSTRING]);UP.FinishFuncBody()
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("stack:%t:%v:%d",GRAPH.CurFunc==checkedFn,innerTmp.Sym(),len(UP.Target.Funcs)))
 UP.FinishFuncBody();UP.CheckFuncStack()
 call:=UP.Call(pos,checkedFn.Nname,[]ir.Node{GRAPH.NewInt(pos,9)},false)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("call:%v:%v:%v:%d:%t",call,call.Op(),call.Type(),call.Typecheck(),GRAPH.CurFunc==nil))
 builtin:=func(name string,args ...ir.Node)ir.Node{return UP.Call(pos,TY.BuiltinPkg.Lookup(name).Def.(ir.Node),args,false)}
 slice:=GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos,UP.Lookup("slice"),TY.NewSlice(TY.Types[types.TINT]));slice.Class=ir.PEXTERN
 mapping:=GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos,UP.Lookup("mapping"),TY.NewMap(TY.Types[types.TSTRING],TY.Types[types.TINT]));mapping.Class=ir.PEXTERN
 for _,expr:=range []ir.Node{
 builtin("len",slice),builtin("cap",slice),builtin("append",slice,GRAPH.NewInt(pos,5)),
 builtin("make",GRAPH.TypeNode(slice.Type()),GRAPH.NewInt(pos,4)),builtin("new",GRAPH.TypeNode(TY.Types[types.TINT])),
 UP.Expr(GRAPH.NewIndexExpr(pos,mapping,GRAPH.NewString(pos,"key"))),
 UP.Expr(GRAPH.NewIndexExpr(pos,slice,GRAPH.NewInt(pos,1))),
 UP.AssignConv(GRAPH.NewInt(pos,7),TY.Types[types.TINTER],"interface assignment"),
 UP.DefaultLit(GRAPH.NewInt(pos,8),TY.Types[types.TINT32]),
 }{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("expr:%v:%v:%v:%d",expr,expr.Op(),expr.Type(),expr.Typecheck()))}
 tmp.SetByval(true);innerTmp.SetByval(false)
 iter:=UP.NewClosureStructIter([]*ir.Name{tmp,innerTmp})
 for {n,typ,offset:=iter.Next();if n==nil{break};out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("capture:%v:%v:%d",n.Sym(),typ,offset))}
 UP.SetBaseTypeIndex(TY.Types[types.TINT],17,18)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("index:%d:%d:%d",UP.BaseTypeIndex(TY.Types[types.TINT]),UP.BaseTypeIndex(TY.NewPtr(TY.Types[types.TINT])),UP.BaseTypeIndex(TY.Types[types.TSTRING])) )

 {
 obj:=GRAPH.NewDeclNameAt(pos,ir.OTYPE,UP.Lookup("Embedded"))
 embedded:=TY.NewNamed(obj);obj.SetType(embedded);obj.SetTypecheck(1)
 member:=TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("Member"),TY.Types[types.TINT])
 embedded.SetUnderlying(TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{member}))
 method:=TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("Method"),TY.NewSignature(TY.NewField(pos,UP.Lookup("recv"),embedded),nil,nil))
 embedded.SetMethods([]*types.Field{method})
 outerObj:=GRAPH.NewDeclNameAt(pos,ir.OTYPE,UP.Lookup("Outer"))
 outer:=TY.NewNamed(outerObj);outerObj.SetType(outer);outerObj.SetTypecheck(1)
 field:=TY.NewField(pos,obj.Sym(),embedded);field.Embedded=1
 outer.SetUnderlying(TY.NewStruct([]*types.Field{field}))
 n:=GRAPH.NewNameAt(pos,UP.Lookup("outer"),outer);n.Class=ir.PEXTERN
 dot:=UP.Expr(UP.AddImplicitDots(GRAPH.NewSelectorExpr(pos,ir.ODOT,n,member.Sym))).(*ir.SelectorExpr)
 UP.CalcMethods(outer)
 out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("embedding:%v:%v:%t:%t:%v:%v:%d",dot,dot.Type(),dot.Selection==member,dot.X.(*ir.SelectorExpr).Selection==field,outer.AllMethods()[0].Sym,outer.AllMethods()[0].Type,outer.AllMethods()[0].Embedded))
 }
 b,err:=json.Marshal(out);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};fmt.Println("SYNCGO_IR="+string(b))
}
